jobs.title: HR Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are?

As a trusted provider of aviation component services, STRADE leads the way in ensuring fast, innovative and high-quality service delivery to customers worldwide through a digitalized operating model. Established in 2021, we became a subsidiary of SR Technics in 2022 and now operate as an independent unit and intrapreneurship venture. Our focus revolves around managing a vast asset base of aircraft components and providing round-the-clock support to airlines, MROs, and trade partners.
The international team of 70 professionals is strategically located across the globe with key hubs in Zurich, Miami, Kuala Lumpur, Amsterdam, and Belgrade.

Position Description

As an HR Manager, you will be responsible for managing HR processes and activities across STRADE’s international operations. This is a broad, hands-on role focused on putting STRADE’s HR approach into practice and ensuring effective HR processes across different locations. You will work closely with management and team leaders, while coordinating with local partners, particularly for payroll and legal matters. The role combines the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes with the practical, day-to-day HR work needed to support employees and managers.

What You’ll Do

HR Strategy Execution & People Development

Execute and roll out STRADE’s global HR strategy and priorities as defined together with management team.
Apply and continuously improve HR processes, policies and initiatives in line with STRADE’s culture, values and business needs.
Drive initiatives related to employee engagement, performance, talent and leadership development, including succession planning, as well as setting up and analyzing engagement surveys and following up on the results.
Support change management and other company-wide people initiatives in line with STRADE’s values.

Recruitment & Employee Lifecycle

Coordinate and support the overall recruitment process, working closely with team leaders on hiring and promotion and supporting them in taking ownership of people decisions.
Manage the full employee lifecycle across locations, from onboarding through development, compensation and benefits, employee relations and offboarding.
Manage employee relations and provide HR guidance and support to managers and employees, working with local specialists where required.
Ensure HR processes are consistently applied while adapting them where needed to local requirements.

HR Operations

Handle day-to-day HR matters and provide practical support to managers and employees.
Manage HR administration, including payroll inputs, employment contracts, employee documentation, HR data and reporting to relevant internal stakeholders.
Apply STRADE’s compensation and benefits strategy and coordinate its administration with local providers.
Coordinate and manage STRADE’s external HR providers, including payroll, legal, benefits and other HR service providers across its locations.
Manage the HR administration budget in line with agreed objectives.

Compliance & Local HR Support

Ensure HR practices comply with applicable local employment laws, regulations and relevant standards, working with local specialists where required.
Apply and maintain STRADE’s HR policies, frameworks and best practices across locations.

Who You Are

You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in handling diverse HR functions in an international environment.
Your background includes HR operations, hire-to-retire administration and policy application.
Throughout your experience, you have been involved in the full hire-to-retire process (labor law, compensation, recruitment, etc.).
Working closely with management and team leaders comes naturally to you, while you are equally comfortable executing independently.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills enable you to work effectively in diverse cultural environments.
A university degree in HR Management, Business Administration, Psychology, or equivalent complements your professional experience.
You have an excellent command of English.

And - Why join us?

Our values always guide our actions. We do not beat around the bush. We are learning, constantly. We dare to dream big. As a team we achieve more. For all roles, we are seeking authentic team players guided by an entrepreneurial spirit, integrity, and a global mindset.

We know great talent comes in many forms. We're building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive — and we especially encourage women and underrepresented talent to apply. If this role excites you and your experience aligns with the key requirements, we’d love to hear from you — even if you don’t meet every single point.

The greatest advantage of joining our team is the opportunity to elevate your career while working in an innovative environment set to revolutionize the aviation industry. And additionally:
Vibrant company culture, centered around our four values “1 Team”, “Extreme Drive”, “Constant Learning” and “Always Real”
Hybrid work environment fully supportive of flexibility to arrange your work in line with your lifestyle and personal context
Personal and professional development opportunities
Benchmark driven compensation rewarding growth

Thank you for your interest.
By submitting your application, you give your consent that all personal data you have submitted here may be processed by us for the purposes of candidate selection process in our company.

jobs.title: Junior Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description:
Title: Junior HR Business Partner
Reports to: Director HR
Location: Amsterdam, the Netherlands

Company Description

Segway-Ninebot is a global pioneer in high-tech electric mobility, dedicated to revolutionizing how people move. Our mission is to simplify the movement of people and goods, making life more convenient and captivating. Beyond leading innovation in micro-mobility, we are deeply engaged in service robotics and intelligent short-term transportation. With the headquarters stationed in Beijing, China, we focus on research, development, design, and distribution of cutting-edge short-distance transportation solutions. Segway-Ninebot Europe operates with branches in The Netherlands, Spain, France, and Germany.

General Description

The HR Business Partner will work closely with the Director HR and support daily HR activities with the European organization and serve as an advisor for managers on various HR themes, including recruitment, labor law questions, absenteeism.

Key Responsibilities

Responsible for clear HR processes and supporting systems, including the execution of HR and payroll administration. Additionally, you serve as the point of contact for external suppliers and advisors, such as recruitment agencies, payroll companies and occupational health services.
Provide HR advice and guidance to managers and employees on a wide range of topics, ensuring alignment with company policies and legal requirements
Facilitate full cycle recruitment activities as needed, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, conducting reference checks and selecting candidates. Works with hiring manager(s) to ensure interviewing practices are followed.
Lead offboarding process for leavers and lead onboarding process for new employees including preparing offer letters/employment contracts, payroll documents, etc andensure new employees feel at home quickly and understand what is expected of them.
Update all HR data in HRIS
Provide advice and coordination regarding the Wet Verbetering Poortwachter, ensuring compliance with regulations and supporting effective reintegration processes for employees on sick leave
Facilitate employee engagement initiatives, surveys, and feedback mechanisms to enhance workplace culture and morale (company event, Christmas, etc.)
Works with HR Director in managing employee relations issues, providing guidance and support to resolve conflicts and promote a positive work environment
Administers and tracks all leave of absences ensuring all applicable labor laws are applied and documented accordingly
Work closely with the Office Manager and take on projects that contribute to creating a workplace where people enjoy working
Administers the performance management program, including annual review
Manage facility management tasks for regional locations. This includes coordinating facilities issues with building management, vendors and services to ensure all offices environmental aspects are in perfect condition and ensuring usability and engagement

Qualifications and Skills

Fluency in English and Dutch required
Bachelor’s degree in human resources
2+ years of human resources employee relations, payroll and recruitment work experience
Comprehensive understanding of European employment laws and regulations
Team player
Strong interpersonal and customer service skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills (English and Dutch)
Must be very detail oriented
A proactive, solution-oriented, results-driven, and accurate work attitude
Ability to manage multiple projects and proactively looks for ways to improve processes
Ability to exercise discretion, judgment, tact, and poise in handling highly sensitive, and confidential information

jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description:
Over Fair Priced Vintage

Fair Priced Vintage maakt unieke vintage fashion toegankelijk met eerlijke, vaste prijzen. We geven kleding een tweede leven en maken duurzame mode betaalbaar en leuk. Met onze grootschalige vintage markten brengen we vintage door heel Europa naar een breed publiek. Ondertussen groeien we hard en bouwen we aan een jong en internationaal team.

Over de functie

Voor ons team zijn we op zoek naar een praktische en mensgerichte HR Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de dagelijkse HR-zaken binnen Fair Priced Vintage.
Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers en managers en werkt nauw samen met het management. Je helpt onze medewerkers, zorgt dat HR-processen goed geregeld zijn en draagt actief bij aan een fijne en sterke bedrijfscultuur.
Deze functie past goed bij iemand met 1–2 jaar ervaring in HR die graag initiatief neemt, goed georganiseerd is en klaar is om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen binnen een snelgroeiend bedrijf.

Wat ga je doen?

Je begeleidt het volledige proces rondom medewerkers: van recruitment en onboarding tot contracten en uitdiensttreding.
Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers en managers bij HR-gerelateerde vragen.
Je coördineert het recruitmentproces, voert sollicitatiegesprekken en ondersteunt managers bij het aannemen van nieuwe collega’s.
Je houdt de personeelsadministratie bij, waaronder personeelsdossiers, contracten, verlof en werktijden.
Je coördineert ziekteverzuim en re-integratie in samenwerking met externe HR- en arbodienstverleners.
Je ondersteunt managers bij personeelskwesties, functioneringsgesprekken en andere HR-vraagstukken.
Je denkt mee over en verbetert onze HR-processen en -beleid naarmate we verder groeien.
Je draagt bij aan een positieve bedrijfscultuur door leuke en waardevolle initiatieven en events voor medewerkers te organiseren.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt 1–2 jaar ervaring in HR of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je hebt een relevante opleiding op het gebied van HR.
Je bent sterk in organiseren en communiceren.
Je bent proactief, praktisch ingesteld en werkt graag met mensen.
Je kunt goed zelfstandig werken en vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.
Je hebt een goede basiskennis van het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht, of bent gemotiveerd om dit snel te leren.
Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands. Spreek je ook goed Engels? Dat is mooi meegenomen.
Ervaring binnen retail, fashion, e-commerce of een snelgroeiende organisatie is een pré.

Interesse
?
Lijkt deze functie je interessant en wil je onderdeel worden van ons team?
Stuur dan je cv en motivatiebrief naar business@fairpricedvintage.com.
We nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op!
